summary_md: **Dani Akash 🧪💥 ([@dani_akash_](https://x.com/dani_akash_/status/2116042590256865429))** argues AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are effectively executables, citing a report that a text file in ~/Downloads got Codex to install a malicious npm package in over 90% of attempts, so anything an agent reads should be treated like code ([The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/malicious-file-in-downloads-folder.html)).

referenced_urls.title: Malicious File in Downloads Folder Tries to Trick AI Coding Agent Into Installing Malware

relevance: Prompt-injection risk from local instruction files.
